_doc: Per Sapphire tileset: metatile ids (secondary ids + 0x200) b2tools/models_cave.py can't tell from collision and behaviour alone. boulder: a blocked tile drawn as a loose rock on the floor (-> Black 2's drock02/drock01 models when it touches walkable floor); ladder_up / ladder_down: ladder art (a ladder up a rock face / down a hole). Filled from screenshots/sapphire renders and work/agents/cave_builder/sheets (metatile sheets with ids). gTileset_RusturfTunnel 0x203 (round rock) / 0x204 (rock cluster) on floor-coloured ground; gTileset_Lavaridge 0x30d (Fiery Path's small rocks). gTileset_MeteorFalls 0x20e (two pointed rocks) / 0x20f (round rock cluster) / 0x21f (rock cluster) on floor-coloured ground (sweep_outdoor 2026-10-11: drawn as flat rock tops level with the floor before, walk_diff OPEN). Granite's 0x203 is rubble on the rock colour (wall), not a boulder. bridge (caves_east): Victory Road's plank bridge metatiles (top row 0x2bb-0x2bd, bottom row 0x2c3-0x2c5; the middle 0x2bc/0x2c4 also on the elevation-15 crossings): walkable tiles drawn as Black 2's bridge deck over a chasm (b2tools/models_cave_levels.py, recipe "bridges"). caves_misc: gTileset_Cave 0x37a / 0x37e (ice rock clusters) / 0x37d (ice rock): Shoal Cave's ice room (no other layout uses them).

emerald:gTileset_NavelRock._doc: Emerald's Navel Rock (events agent): ladder art up (0x217 caves, 0x366 the second ladder room, 0x38b the bottom) and down (0x23f)

emerald:gTileset_Cave._doc: Emerald's gTileset_Cave in Altering Cave (postgame_maps 2026-10-07): its loose rock piles are 0x250 and 0x266 (blocked, drawn as rocks on the floor; Ruby's boulder 0x218 is a cliff corner in Emerald's art)

emerald_view:gTileset_Cave._doc: Emerald's gTileset_Cave as the Emerald-world caves read it (models_cave.py 'emerald/<Map>' recipes; emerald_caves 2026-10-12, metatile sheets work/agents/emerald_caves/sheets): loose rock piles 0x202/0x203/0x21f/0x227 (+ Altering Cave's 0x250/0x266, the Cave of Origin's round rock 0x330); Ruby's 0x218/0x253/0x262 are cliff pieces in Emerald's. Ladder and plank-bridge art at Ruby's ids (drawn alike).

emerald_view:gTileset_MeteorFalls._doc: Emerald's gTileset_MeteorFalls (emerald_caves): Ruby's rock piles 0x20e/0x20f/0x21f at the same ids, + 0x28c

emerald_view:gTileset_Lavaridge._doc: Emerald's gTileset_Lavaridge (the Magma Hideout; emerald_caves): no loose rocks (Ruby's 0x30d is lava in Emerald's)
